components.name: Ask Button (primary)
components.description: Primary action: submits the question. Mint fill, bold text, disables to gray with a progress cursor while answering.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #5ef2b8; color: #0e1012; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #7ef5c6; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #2a2f35; color: #9aa3ad; cursor: progress; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5ef2b8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Add a PDF (secondary ghost)
components.description: Secondary action in the sidebar: opens the file picker to upload a PDF.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { appearance: none; align-self: flex-start; border: 1px solid #2a2f35; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #e7eaee; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #9aa3ad; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5ef2b8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Document Remove (two-step confirm)
components.description: Inline destructive control: first click swaps label to red 'Confirm' for ~4s instead of opening a modal.
components.css: .ds-remove { appearance: none; border: 1px solid #2a2f35; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #9aa3ad; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-remove:hover { color: #ff6b6b; border-color: #ff6b6b; } .ds-remove--confirming { color: #ff6b6b; border-color: #ff6b6b; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; }

components.name: Example Question Chip
components.description: One-shot suggestion chip; clicking populates the ask textarea with its text.
components.css: .ds-chip { appearance: none; border: 1px solid #2a2f35; border-radius: 999px; background: #1b1f23; color: #e7eaee; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #9aa3ad; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5ef2b8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ask Textarea
components.description: Multi-line question input with mint caret, part of the command-bar ask form.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-textarea" rows="2" maxlength="500" placeholder="e.g. What are your hours on Sunday?"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-textarea { width: 100%; resize: vertical; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #2a2f35; border-radius: 8px; background: #1b1f23; color: #e7eaee; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.4; caret-color: #5ef2b8; } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: #9aa3ad; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5ef2b8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: #1b1f23; border: 1px solid #2a2f35; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 8px 20px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); animation: ds-card-enter 200ms ease-out both; } @keyframes ds-card-enter { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .ds-card-question { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #9aa3ad; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #e7eaee; } .ds-card-label { margin-top: 1rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #9aa3ad; } .ds-source { margin-top: 0.5rem; border-top: 1px solid #2a2f35; padding-top: 0.75rem; } .ds-source-head { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #9aa3ad; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-source-passage { font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #e7eaee; } .ds-mark { background: rgba(94,242,184,0.16); color: #e7eaee; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #5ef2b8; text-underline-offset: 0.15em; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0 0.15em; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card { animation: none !important; opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; } }

narrative.overview: A near-black workspace built for someone verifying machine-generated answers against source documents, not a marketing surface. The sidebar is a document manifest, not a nav decoration; the main panel is a command bar feeding a stack of evidence cards. Density is calm and functional: one accent color, flat surfaces that step up in lightness (not shadow) to signal hierarchy, and a single quiet entrance animation reserved for new answers. This build replaced an earlier kitchen-ticket-rail direction entirely; it refuses chat-bubble threads, decorative accent bars, and anything that performs warmth instead of trust.
keyCharacteristics: Three-step dark surface stack (page → sidebar/card → border) instead of shadows for separation.
One mint accent used only for the primary action, focus rings, and quote highlighting — never decoration.
Condensed display face reserved for the wordmark alone; every control uses the system sans stack.
Monospace reserved for data (counts, source locations, retrieved-passage scores), never for prose.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Mint appears only on the Ask action, focus states, the caret, and the quote highlight. No other UI element borrows it for emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The Tonal-Step Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from three ascending surface lightness steps (page → sidebar/card → nothing brighter), not from multiple shadow weights or colored overlays.

rules.name: The One Display Face Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed renders the wordmark and nothing else. Every button, label, card, and data value uses the system sans or mono stack.

rules.name: The No-Hard-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse and low-opacity. No offset "sticker" or hard-edge shadow appears anywhere in this system.

dos: Do keep mint to exactly one functional accent: the Ask button, focus rings, the caret, and quote highlights.
Do use the ascending tonal stack (void → sidebar/card → hairline border) for all hierarchy and separation instead of adding new shadow weights.
Do reserve Barlow Condensed for the wordmark only; every other text element uses the system sans or mono stack.
Do use the two-step inline confirm pattern (button text swaps to red "Confirm" for ~4s) for any future destructive action instead of a modal dialog.
Do disable the card-enter animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; it is the only authored motion in the system and must stay optional.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color or a decorative gradient; the One Accent Rule covers the whole system.
Don't add hard-edged "sticker" shadows or offset borders; this is not a neobrutalist world, and the Ambient Card shadow is the only shadow token.
Don't add kicker/eyebrow labels above headings as a decorative device; the uppercase Label style exists only as a functional section header ("Sources") inside a card, never as ornament.
Don't reintroduce the earlier kitchen-ticket-rail visual language (paper texture, ticket perforation, warm palette); that world was explicitly replaced by this dark app shell.
